description: What looks like a recurring bill in the imported transactions but has not been confirmed as one: the merchant, the typical charge and its amortized monthly share, the cadence, how many months it was seen in, how much the amount and the day move, and how confident the detector is. Merchants already tracked or previously dismissed are excluded. This is the question `fixed_expenses` answers the other half of — that one lists what is already committed. Reads the document; changes nothing.

ending_at.description: The newest month of the window, as YYYY-MM. Default this month.

include_dismissed.description: Also list the merchants that were said no to.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

window_months.description: How many months of history to look at, 2–24. Default 3. A window cannot see a cadence longer than itself: use 12 to find yearly charges.

name: fixed_expense_candidates
title: Recurring charges the ledger suggests
